floater.name: wolf_tunnels
floater.title: Tunnels
floater.floater.string: This region cannot make tunnels yet (it needs the WolfSim tunnels update). Ask the region owner.
Only the region owner, the estate owner and estate managers can make tunnels here.

scroll_list.name: tun_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: This region's tunnels. Pick one to change it, delete it or go inside.

button.label: Change
button.name: edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Change the tunnel picked in the list, then build it again

button.label: Go inside
button.name: go_tunnel_btn
button.tool_tip: Teleport to the floor just inside the picked tunnel's first mouth

button.label: Delete
button.name: delete_tunnel_btn
button.tool_tip: Take the picked tunnel away: its rock, its walkable boxes and its record (asks first)

line_editor.name: tun_name
line_editor.tool_tip: The tunnel's name (also the rock object's name)

combo_box.name: tun_kind
combo_box.tool_tip: The tunnel's size. Walking: 4 m wide, 3.5 m high. Wide: 6 x 4.5 m. Rail: 6 x 6 m, for trains. Custom: your own (More options).

button.label: Draw / move points
button.name: draw_route_btn
button.tool_tip: Put the pen down: click the ground to add points, drag a point's boxes to move it (press again, Enter or Esc to stop)

button.label: Undo point
button.name: undo_point_btn
button.tool_tip: Take the last point of the route back (Backspace)

button.label: Build tunnel
button.name: build_btn
button.tool_tip: Save the tunnel, make its rock, rez it and make it walkable (an old build of it is taken away first)

button.label: Stop editing
button.name: cancel_edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Put the drawing away without building it

check_box.label: More options (depth, style, size, caverns, see-through)
check_box.name: more_check
check_box.tool_tip: Show the settings most tunnels do not need

spinner.label: Depth below ground (m)
spinner.name: tun_depth
spinner.tool_tip: How deep the points between the mouths go under the ground, at most, metres. The floor slopes down to it gently, so short tunnels stay shallower.

check_box.label: Mouths at ground level
check_box.name: tun_mouths
check_box.tool_tip: The first and last points sit on the ground so people can walk in; the points between go in at the depth

spinner.label: Depth
spinner.name: pt_depth
spinner.tool_tip: How far the picked point's floor is below the ground there, metres (less than 0: above the ground)

button.label: To ground level
button.name: pt_ground
button.tool_tip: Put the picked point's floor on the ground

button.label: Remove point
button.name: pt_remove
button.tool_tip: Take the picked point out of the route (Delete)

radio_group.name: tun_style
radio_group.tool_tip: Smooth: engineered, straight walls, level floor, arched roof (railways, roads). Rough: a natural cave, uneven rock, changing width, bumpy roof.

check_box.label: Stone arches at the mouths
check_box.name: tun_portals
check_box.tool_tip: A stone portal round each mouth

text.name: grade_info
text.tool_tip: The floor runs straight from each point to the next, at each point's own depth

button.label: Add cavern
button.name: cavern_btn
button.tool_tip: Put the pen down to click caverns onto the route (press again to stop)

slider.label: Cavern size
slider.name: cavern_r
slider.tool_tip: Radius of the next cavern, metres (3 to 30)

check_box.label: See through the ground
check_box.name: see_through
check_box.tool_tip: While this window is open the ground is half see-through, so the route and the tunnels inside the hill show. It goes back to normal when the window closes.

slider.label: How much (%)
slider.name: see_through_amount
slider.tool_tip: How see-through the ground is: 25% (mostly solid) to 75% (mostly clear). It never goes fully clear, so you still see where the ground is.

check_box.label: The region's walkable boxes (expert)
check_box.name: advanced_check
check_box.tool_tip: Every walkable box in this region, with its numbers

scroll_list.name: box_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: This region's walkable boxes. Pick one to see its numbers and change them.

button.label: Refresh
button.name: refresh_btn
button.tool_tip: Read this region's tunnels and boxes again

check_box.label: Show the boxes in the world
check_box.name: show_outlines
check_box.tool_tip: Outlines of the walkable boxes, drawn through the ground, while this window is open

button.label: Delete box
button.name: delete_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove the picked box from the region (asks first)

button.label: Go inside
button.name: go_btn
button.tool_tip: Teleport to the floor of the picked box

button.label: Save changes
button.name: save_btn
button.tool_tip: Save the picked box's new numbers to the region
